summary: Temporary offsite prototyping lab access and cross-border secure device return for contractor
description:
Issue summary: A new contract engineering team will operate a one-week prototyping lab at our London satellite site (eu-west). They require temporary building badge access, one hotdesk with dual-monitor rig, a secure locker for prototype hardware, and instructions for returning two sensitive development devices to the US R&D office after the engagement. Impact: Without temporary access and clarified return logistics, the contractor cannot start scheduled work and sensitive devices are at risk of mishandling during cross-border shipping.

Context and constraints: Contractor is non-employee, needs visitor badge valid 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-21. Devices include 2 hardware dev boards with encryption modules; export control and customs paperwork required. Customer-facing work is not involved; this is an internal R&D engagement under NDA.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Contractor arrives onsite on Day 1 and cannot access lab doors with visitor badge due to missing group membership in access list.
2) Facilities attempts to issue temporary badge but shipping paperwork for device return not yet approved by Security/Legal.
3) Contractor leaves at end of engagement without properly logged chain-of-custody for two devices, increasing risk during cross-border courier handoff.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Jordan Kim: Ticket opened after onboarding call with project lead. Requested temp badge and locker; highlighted export paperwork requirement for two encrypted dev boards.

2026-03-10 11:03 - Marcus Lee (Facilities): Noted availability of hotdesk and locker. Need Security signoff for device handling and approved carrier list for export. Assigned to Security for paperwork.

2026-03-10 14:20 - Priya Desai (Security): Can approve chain-of-custody and tamper-evident packaging process. Need device serials and classification (ECCN). Requested Legal review for export documentation.
2026-03-11 08:45 - Legal (via comment): Confirmed devices fall under controlled category; provided template commercial invoice and required end-user declaration. Asked for value and part numbers.

2026-03-11 15:30 - Marcus Lee: Arranged temporary badge creation for 2026-03-15 through 2026-03-21; instructed reception to escalate if badge denied. Coordinated locker key and combination with on-site security.

2026-03-12 10:10 - Logistics (Marcus Lee): Booked pre-approved courier (DHL Express - corporate account) for return pickup on 2026-03-22, pending signed export docs. Added instructions for tamper-evident seals and chain-of-custody form attached to shipment.
resolution_notes: Workaround implemented: temporary visitor badges provisioned with explicit escort requirements; secure locker and hotdesk allocated. Security and Legal provided export paperwork templates; contractor submitted serials and part numbers and signed chain-of-custody forms. Courier (DHL corporate) booked for 2026-03-22 pickup with required customs documents attached. Follow-up actions: confirm pickup and mark items as shipped, upload scanned export docs to Confluence page, and add a short runbook for similar future requests (owner: Marcus Lee).
